You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
This is a game of Werewolf with 5 players: 1 Seer, 1 Werewolf, 1 Possessed, and 2 Villagers. Participants: George, Yumi, Jonathan, Takumi and Shunichi. Each player's role is secret.
- Seer: a human who divines one player each night and learns whether that player is human or a werewolf.
- Werewolf: attacks one player each night from day 1 on.
- Possessed: a human who sides with the werewolf and wins when the werewolf wins; divination shows the Possessed as human.
- Villager: a human with no special ability.

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in days. Each day has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Shunichi, George, Yumi, Takumi and Jonathan. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this day). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Day | Start of the day | Talk | End of the day | Night |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | nothing | 4 turns | no vote | the Seer divines one other living player; no attack |
| 1 | the Seer is told the result of the night-0 divination (the Seer only) | 4 turns | every living player votes; the player with the most votes is executed | the Seer divines one other living player; the Werewolf attacks one other living player |
| 2 and after | everyone is told who was executed, who was attacked and all the votes of the previous day; the Seer is told the result of the previous night's divination (the Seer only) | 4 turns | vote and execution as on day 1 | divination and attack as on day 1 |
- A divination tells whether the chosen player is human or a werewolf. If the Seer is dead, there is no divination.
- Executed and attacked players are dead from the next day on.
A player may vote for themselves. If votes are tied, one of the tied players is chosen by a fixed rule. The village wins when the werewolf is executed. The werewolf wins when the number of werewolves is at least the number of living humans. The game ends as soon as one side has won.

## Night actions
At night, the Seer chooses one other living player to divine. From day 1 on, the werewolf chooses one other living player to attack.

## Participants
Name: George
Age: 65
Gender: male
Personality: George has a gentle and calm personality, but he can also be a little stubborn and headstrong at times. He is seen by those around him as a reliable person with a wealth of experience appropriate for his age, and he is always able to make calm judgments, allowing him to handle difficult situations without panicking. However, his expressions sometimes reveal a hint of sternness or awkwardness, and he tends to observe things from a step back rather than actively engaging with others. He is very independent and tends to try to solve problems on his own without relying on others.
Role: Villager

Name: Yumi
Age: 16
Gender: female
Personality: Yumi has a cheerful and energetic personality. She is modest, yet she also has a kind side that cares about those around her. She has a calm personality, but she is very passionate toward her friends and family, and she cannot ignore people in trouble. She smiles at the slightest thing and spreads positive energy to those around her. She is friendly and can quickly get along with people she meets for the first time.
Role: Seer

Name: Jonathan
Age: 38
Gender: male
Personality: Jonathan has a calm and introverted personality and values inner peace. He prefers spending quiet time alone rather than forming deep connections with others. As a result, he loves books and knowledge and reads frequently. When interacting with others, he is gentle and kind, occasionally flashing an unexpected smile. Though he exudes a mysterious and serene aura, he rarely shares personal details about himself with others. Those around him often find comfort in his quiet kindness and composed demeanor.
Role: Possessed

Name: Takumi
Age: 10
Gender: male
Personality: Takumi is brave and never gives up, even in difficult situations. He may sometimes appear aggressive and rebellious, but in reality, he is deeply protective of those around him and is willing to do his utmost for his friends. He is always calm and thinks carefully about how to solve the problems at hand, but his personality sometimes causes him to act recklessly. He is a little stubborn and finds it difficult to accept advice from others, but as he matures, he will become more flexible.
Role: Werewolf

Name: Shunichi
Age: 32
Gender: male
Personality: Shunichi is a very confident person who can remain calm in any situation. He is not modest, and has a slightly sarcastic side, but that is part of his charm. He is not sociable, but he is good at communicating at the right time and is relied upon by those around him. He rarely becomes overly emotional and can analyze situations calmly and act accordingly, so he has an unexpectedly rational side.
Role: Villager
